select.if: select *, timestampdiff(day, lastDate, now()) as deleteDiff from member order by idx desc limit #{startIndexNo}, #{pageSize};
select *, timestampdiff(day, lastDate, now()) as deleteDiff from member where level=#{level} order by idx desc limit #{startIndexNo}, #{pageSize};

mapper.select: select *, timestampdiff(day, lastDate, now()) as deleteDiff from member where level=#{level} order by idx desc limit #{startIndexNo}, #{pageSize};
select * from member where date(startDate) >= date(subdate(now(),INTERVAL 7 DAY)) and date(startDate) <= date(now()) order by idx desc limit #{startIndexNo}, #{pageSize};
mapper.update: update member set level = #{levelItem} where idx = #{idx};
